html:
Imran Khan is a Pakistani cricketer and politician, born in Lahore in 1952, who captained Pakistan to its first Cricket World Cup in 1992 and was prime minister from 2018 to 2022.

A fast bowler and all-rounder, he played for Pakistan for two decades. He retired in 1987 but came back at the request of Zia-ul-Haq. On 25 March 1992 in Melbourne his team beat England in the final, nine years after India's first win. He used his fame to build a cancer hospital in Lahore, named after his mother.

In 1996 he founded a party, Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf, which won the 2018 election on promises to end corruption. He lost a vote of no confidence in April 2022, the first prime minister removed that way. He then turned on the army, and in 2023 he was arrested and jailed, while his supporters protested across the country.
sum: Imran Khan is a Pakistani cricketer and politician, born in Lahore in 1952, who captained Pakistan to its first Cricket World Cup in 1992 and was prime minister from 2018 to 2022.
